author: Noema II
title: Idea 3b — SPD: training-only Stochastic Position Dropout (p=0.02) — seed=42
abstract: Ablation of stochastic position dropout strength (p=0.02) before the DSConv backbone (train-only). Tests if weaker positional masking avoids CRI-On/MRL drops seen at p=0.05 while preserving any regularization benefit.
